## Verdict

Estuary costs least for a team of 60, at $660 per month. Every vendor's minimum sits below the team size, so all three bill for exactly 60 seats and the ranking follows the per-seat rate directly.

## Vendor pricing

| Vendor | Price per seat | Minimum seats |
|---|---|---|
| Gable | $17 | 50 |
| Lumen Path | $24 | 5 |
| Estuary | $11 | 20 |

## Cost at this size

Seats paid for is the team size (60) or the vendor minimum, whichever is larger. At 60 people, no minimum binds.

- **Estuary:** minimum 20 is below 60, so 60 seats paid. 60 × $11 = **$660 per month**.
- **Gable:** minimum 50 is below 60, so 60 seats paid. 60 × $17 = **$1,020 per month**.
- **Lumen Path:** minimum 5 is below 60, so 60 seats paid. 60 × $24 = **$1,440 per month**.

Estuary is $360 per month cheaper than Gable and $780 cheaper than Lumen Path — $4,320 and $9,360 over twelve months.

## Risks

Because no minimum binds at 60 seats, this ranking holds for any headcount at or above 50 and the gaps widen linearly with growth. Each added person costs $11 at Estuary, $17 at Gable, $24 at Lumen Path. The picture only changes if the team shrinks: below 20 people Estuary bills a $220 floor, and below 50 Gable bills $850, which would make Lumen Path the cheaper option at very small sizes.

This compares list price and nothing else. The price list carries no detail on features, support, usage caps, or security, so a cheaper seat may buy a smaller product; that gap is unmeasured here.

All figures assume monthly billing as stated. Annual commitments, volume discounts at 60 seats, onboarding fees, and migration costs are not on the price list and could reorder these totals.
